place-value-number-sense-skill-01.obj: explain that a digit is worth 10 times as much as the same digit one place to its right
place-value-number-sense-skill-01.idea: Each place is worth 10 times the place to its right. The same digit can have different values in different places.
voc: The value a digit has because of where it is in a number.
A group of three digits in a number, separated by a comma.
A number written as the sum of the values of its digits.
place-value-number-sense-skill-01.watch: Digit or value?: the digit is 7, the value might be 700 or 7,000. Do not skip a place: 5,032 is not 532.

cards.big: Each place is worth 10 times the place to its right. The same digit can have different values in different places.
steps: Read the thousands period, say “thousand,” then read the rest.
Use zeros to hold empty places: thirty thousand, twelve is 30,012.
Example: Write 52,706 in expanded form. Answer: 50,000 + 2,000 + 700 + 6
